- **CMV**: Shoestring, malformed, mosaic leaves — no match.
- **Early Blight**: Dark brown necrotic lesions with concentric rings in dead tissue — no match.
- **Septoria**: Small dark spots on yellowed leaf — no match.
- **Bacterial Speck**: Small black pinpoint spots — no match.
- All other classes (Gray Mold, Powdery Mildew, Verticillium, Bacterial Canker, etc.): No ring patterns, completely different symptom types.

The ringspot/concentric ring pattern on green leaf tissue is the hallmark of Tomato Spotted Wilt Virus and matches the reference exactly.
